component.name: Waves
component.summary: Save music from your own TIDAL account for offline listening

description.p: A native desktop app for saving music from your own TIDAL account for offline listening: search-first, art-forward, and built for people who'd rather click than type. Browse TIDAL's shelves, search across artists, albums, tracks and videos, and save a track, an album, a playlist or an artist's whole discography in one click, up to hi-res lossless and Dolby Atmos.

A paid TIDAL plan is required. Waves saves from your own account, for your personal, non-commercial use, and can only save what your account can play. On first run it opens TIDAL's own login page in your browser and never sees your password. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by TIDAL.
